title: Nafta Ka Dambeysa Sanamka
intro: Iyada oo hooska ka baxsashada weyn ee ka dhanka ah kalitalisnimada, qofkan qarsoodiga ah ayaa cidlada ku sugayay. Intii hoggaamiyaha dad la doortay uu fuulay buur barakeysan si uu u helo wadaag rabbaani ah, waxaa ku soo degtay tijaabadii weynayd kuwii ka haray. Qofkani wuxuu qaatay fursadda si uu dib ugu qaabeeyo caqiidooyinka bulsho dhan. Markii hoggaamiyuhu uu soo laabtay isagoo run sheegaya, waxaa la xukumay ciqaab gaar ah oo weligeed ah. Ma kala furfuri kartaa qofka ay tahay ruuxan muranka badan iyo khiyaanada badan?
clues: Waxaan la safray dad laga xoreeyay gacanta dulmiilaha awoodda badan iyada oo loo marayo calaamado mucjiso ah.
Markii hoggaamiyahooda uu buurta u baxay si uu u helo hanuun, waxaan ku dhex sugnaa kuwa ka haray.
Waxaan ka soo ururiyay biraha qaaliga ah qurxintooda oo waxaan u sameeyay wax soo saara cod.
Abuurkan awgiis, waxaan ku qanciyay jiil dhan inay ilaahood ka heleen cidlada.
Markii hoggaamiyihii soo laabtay, waa la i soo koobay oo la i weydiiyay waxa igu kallifay khiyaanadaas.
Ciqaabtaydii adduunkan waxay ahayd inaan cidina i taaban ama ii soo dhowaan, calaamad ceeb ah oo aan weligay qaado.

outcome.answer: Waxaa lagu xukumay inaan la taaban karin, iyadoo weligay la leeyahay 'lama xiriirin'

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
